player_prompt.intro:
Dealer nen i Blackburn khelh mek i ni.
I tihtur chu 21 vel a pelh theih nan a, a tello chuang loh nan.
Nang turn ah, '[Hit]' i hmang rawh i card dang khat zawk lak nan emaw '[Stand]' i hmang rawh i a tello nan.
J/Q/K = 10 points; A = 11 emaw 1, i thui tak zawk.
